messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: PAGING: metering-aggregation-service alert. token_count_delta > 8% vs ingest for a subset of customers across eu-west-1. Auto-created thread in #incidents. Please ACK and triage. refs: https://runbook.redwood/metering/aggregation-drift
maria: Ack, I'm oncall. Quick question — is this spike correlated with any deploys in the last 2 hours? Also, which customers are affected? rough estimate of overcounting?
kai: Not seeing recent deploys in prod within 3h. I ran a quick rollup and see ~7-12% divergence on 3% of accounts (mostly high-throughput tenants). Looks like an aggregation job double-processing partial windows when a shard restart happens.
samir: Adding some raw logs from aggregator (sanitized):
```
2024-09-12T14:02:11Z shard-07 received window 2024-09-12T13:30-13:45
2024-09-12T14:02:12Z shard-03 re-emitted checkpoint for same window
2024-09-12T14:02:12Z aggregate: token_sum=120345, previous_token_sum=110000, delta=10345
```
samir: Looks like checkpoint dedupe failed on a subset of shards due to a recent change in the checkpoint key format (minor migration).
opsbot: Runbook link: https://runbook.redwood/metering/aggregation-drift -> Step 1: mute billing alerts for affected customers; Step 2: flip metering_fallback flag; Step 3: backfill corrected aggregates.
maria: Okay. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) mute transient alerting for billing to avoid noisy overage emails; 2) enable metering_fallback to use raw-ingest-based aggregation (less optimized but correct); 3) start backfill task to recompute last 24h for affected tenants. Who can flip the flag and run backfill?
kai: I can flip the flag. Doing: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/featureflags/meters -d '{ "metering_fallback": true }'` -> response 200
samir: Starting backfill job for window 2024-09-12T00:00 -> 2024-09-12T14:00 for top 50 affected tenants. Kickoff command:
```
./tools/run_backfill --tenants @top50 --start 2024-09-12T00:00 --end 2024-09-12T14:00 --mode strict --dry-run=false
```
samir: backfill submitted (job id bf-20240912-554). ETA ~45m for first progress batch.
jess: Heads-up: billing system already flagged a few overage alerts and one automated invoice was queued. I paused invoice-sender for those tenant IDs to avoid charging customers incorrectly.
maria: Great, thanks Jess. Please prepare a short customer note for CS + AMs: explain we saw incorrect token counts, charges will be reviewed and refunds/adjustments applied as needed. Draft in #customer-success when ready.
opsbot: Incident severity updated to SEV2 -> cause: aggregator checkpoint migration edge-case. Recommend post-incident migration rollback/patch.
kai: Root cause quick summary: migration introduced a key-format mismatch for checkpoint IDs; when shard restarts occurred, dedupe failed and windows were aggregated twice for certain shards. Fix is small: accept legacy key formats during read and trigger a one-time resync.
maria: Timeline so far: 14:02 alert -> 14:05 triage -> 14:10 fallback enabled -> 14:15 backfill started -> 14:20 invoice-sender paused -> 14:45 partial backfill results indicate corrected counts for 60% of affected tenants. No customer-facing charges applied yet (Jess paused). Next: keep backfill running, prepare customer comms, and schedule patch deployment to aggregator to handle legacy checkpoint keys.
aliya: I will take the overnight on-call handoff at 18:00 UTC. @maria, please hand off any remaining tasks. I'll monitor backfill and follow up with AMs.
maria: Handoff ack. Remaining tasks: 1) confirm backfill completes for top50, 2) validate billing reconciliations (Jess), 3) schedule patch deploy for aggregator with QA verification. If backfill stalls, revert to manual correction plan (run delta reconcile script).
samir: Noted. I pushed a hotfix branch that accepts legacy keys and added an idempotency guard. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/meters/pull/789 — will request expedited review.
jess: CS draft posted in #customer-success: short non-technical note + "We're reviewing billing and will apply corrections where needed". Link: https://company.docs/cs/drafts/metering-drift
opsbot: Reminder: follow post-incident checklist and attach all runbook artifacts. Incident owner: maria. Playbook step: issue postmortem within 72h.
aliya: Taking over now. I'll post hourly updates and escalate to infra if backfill error rates go > 5%.
maria: Thanks all. Leaving channel for handoff. :white_check_mark:
aliya: Update 18:30 UTC — backfill job bf-20240912-554 completed processing ~85% of windows; remaining failures are due to transient worker OOMs, retry scheduled. Billing reconciliation queue shows 0 automated invoices processed for affected tenants. Continuing monitoring.
aliya: 20:33 UTC — final validation ran; corrected aggregates applied, billing team to review refunds in morning. Closing incident thread and moving to postmortem prep.
incbot: Incident closed by alias:aliya at 2024-09-12T20:33:00Z. Summary: ~3% tenants affected, peak overcount 12%, mitigations: enabled fallback, backfilled 24h windows, hotfix PR opened. Follow-up: patch deploy and postmortem assigned to maria and samir."
